mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the past 3 months signals an easing monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days during monetary easing cycles.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods with a sustained 3-month FEDFUNDS decline, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5.0% signals a tightening labor market and accelerating economic growth, which boosts corporate earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods where UNRATE < 5.0%, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in monthly payroll employment (PAYEMS) and housing starts (HOUST) signal robust consumer and business demand, accelerating corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods where both PAYEMS and HOUST show positive month-over-month growth, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation regime (CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%), the Federal Reserve is likely to tighten monetary policy, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods in high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%), or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A level of industrial production (INDPRO) above 105.0 (index 2017=100) signals robust manufacturing activity and supply chain strength, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods where INDPRO > 105.0, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts (HOUST) level above 950.0 thousand units signals strong consumer demand for housing and related sectors, accelerating economic growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods where HOUST > 950.0, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A strong quarterly GDP growth rate (GDPC1) above 2.0% signals robust economic expansion, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of periods with quarterly GDP growth above 2.0%, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A payroll employment level (PAYEMS) above 141,000 thousand persons signals a tight labor market and strong economic activity, boosting consumer spending and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of periods where PAYEMS > 141000.0, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window falls below 0.03.
